description: Start here for an unfamiliar repository or a general test-architecture review. Detect and audit all project roots once, then return the complete deterministic summary, blockers, findings, ranking, plan, execution hints, verification commands, and stats. Prefer this over audit_repo unless one project root and adapter were explicitly selected.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection inside detected projects.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional exact project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before analysis.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

name: analyze_repository
title: Analyze Repository
